empty.reason: Only rendered when a date exists to add; the menu always shows Google plus the reminder picker.

single.reason: The preset list is fixed at four or five options, so there is no one-item list to show.

many.reason: The preset list is fixed and short; the phone scenario shows it fitting the narrowest screen.

loading.reason: Pure links rendered on the server; no pending state in the component.

error.reason: No fetch in the component; invalid custom reminders are dropped by the calendar route and unit-tested there.

many.reason: the page has no truncation or pagination yet; the 12-month scenario already renders the whole sample set of seven races

loading.reason: server-rendered with no client fetch, so there is no in-page loading state

error.reason: there is no in-page error state yet; a database failure falls through to the framework error page

loading.reason: The loading line only shows for the instant before saved races and race details arrive; a page capture waits for the settled page. The line itself is captured by the MyRacesLoading - Loading component preview.

single.reason: The page always shows exactly one race; a single-item boundary does not apply

many.reason: Timelines are bounded by each race's real milestones; Big Bear carries the longest real timeline and is covered as typical

loading.reason: Server-rendered page with no client-side fetch, so there is no loading state

key-interaction.reason: The key actions (Register on the official site, Add to calendar, Report a detail) leave the page or download a file; their URLs are unit-tested in raceDetail and raceCalendar tests
